text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"Chasing rabbits on that mountain, fishing 
for minnows in that river... Still in my 
dreams they wander, my unforgettable 
hometown..."♪

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Waaah, amazing, amazing! Big sister, 
you're so good at the piano!

text_block_list.name: Boy A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey! Now that piano's over, play a 
game with me next! Pretty please?!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, of course. I'll play with everyone 
in turn, so just wait a bit.

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text:
"Thanks, Big Sis!" "See ya!" "Practice 
your gaming!" "Thank you for teaching me 
origami!" "Bye-bye!"

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(The time is... okay. At this rate, I 
should make it in time for training.)

text_block_list.name: Boy B
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Big sis, is it time for you to go 
home...?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Huh? Did you just get here?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"...Yeah, I'll hang out here a bit longer. 
Now, what should we play?"

text_block_list.name: Boy B
text_block_list.text:
Wah! I can't read yet, so Big Sis, read it 
for me!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, because of her kind nature, K.S. 
Miracle ended up skipping training.
